final_answer_full:
The mean surface temperature for Singapore on 2023-11-22, derived from Landsat 9 Band 10 thermal infrared data, is **-10.64°C**.

This value was calculated by first determining the mean pixel value in Kelvin (262.51 K) using statistical analysis of the raster data, then converting it to Celsius via the formula:  
**°C = K - 273.15**.  

While surface temperatures in tropical regions like Singapore are typically higher, this result reflects the specific thermal properties of the dataset and potential atmospheric conditions at the time of observation.
